name: use-settings
title: useSettings
description: useSettings: the settings block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the settings block (`npx better-supabase add settings`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/settings.
